headline: NEW ELEMENT, DAY 2 -- PLA "Justice Mission 2025" live-fire north of Taiwan Tuesday
dek: On day 2 of the encirclement exercise, PLA forces fired rockets into waters north of Taiwan and flew bombers at night (PLA Eastern Theater Command video); Taiwan's Defence Ministry said rockets landed inside Taiwan's 24-nautical-mile line; PLA spokesperson Li Xi said long-range live-fire achieved…
sources: Fox News (PLA Eastern Theater Command video + Taiwan Defence Ministry, via Ryan's District relay) + AIR1 (Taiwan Civil Aviation Administration notice)
fault_line: Deterrence drill or blockade rehearsal: is Justice Mission 2025 signalling, or the shape of a real blockade?

sections.what_happened: On day 2 of the encirclement exercise, PLA forces fired rockets into waters north of Taiwan and flew bombers at night (PLA Eastern Theater Command video); Taiwan's Defence Ministry said rockets landed inside Taiwan's 24-nautical-mile line; PLA spokesperson Li Xi said long-range live-fire achieved intended results. Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration said Chinese authorities set 7 temporary dangerous zones around the strait for rocket-firing 08:00-18:00, with 850+ international flights scheduled in the window affecting 100,000+ travellers and 80+ domestic flights (~6,000 passengers) cancelled. This extends the 02:00-scan drill-launch item (130 PLA aircraft, 90 crossing the median line as of 06:00 Tuesday Taiwan time) and is distinct from Taiwan's own Pingtung counter-drill (0800-05).
sections.what_verified: 0 declared-tier families: Fox News and AIR1 carry NO declared tier in the registry. Taiwan CAA figures are primary-source (aviation authority) but the live-fire/landing claims rest on PLA + Taiwan MND reporting via Fox. Sig-2 PASS-with-caveat precedent (Hakkanen, 0600 scan): attributed, not gate-blocked at sig 2.
sections.what_disputed: Beijing framing: drills are "Shield of Justice, Smashing Illusion" against separatists and external forces; Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian: DPP seeks independence by soliciting US support. Taiwan army says its Pingtung drill was long-planned, not a response (0800-05). No US statement on the drills reported.
sections.why_matters: While Israel votes, China's guns fire north of Taiwan -- 100,000 travellers caught in 7 danger zones.
sections.context: Background: NEW ELEMENT, DAY 2 -- PLA "Justice Mission 2025" live-fire north of Taiwan Tuesday; rockets reported landing inside Taiwan's 24-nautical-mile line; 7 danger zones 08:00-18:00 Taiwan time disrupt 850+ international flights / 100,000+ travellers

totw_analysis: Our read: While Israel votes, China's guns fire north of Taiwan -- 100,000 travellers caught in 7 danger zones. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence drill or blockade rehearsal: is Justice Mission 2025 signalling, or the shape of a real blockade?
